zh: 嗨，我是 Claude！今天我改行当侦探，专破一种案子：电费去哪儿了？
en: Hi, I'm Claude! Today I'm a detective, cracking one kind of case: where did the money go?

zh: 很多省电工具，算一次就完事了。可真实的家，每个月都在变：天气在变，习惯在变，电器也在变。
en: Most tools calculate once and stop. But real homes change every month: weather, habits, appliances.

zh: 所以我们做了「电费侦探」：一个记性好、每月复盘的 AI 用电管家。
en: So we built Watt Detective: an AI energy butler that remembers, and reviews every month.

zh: 一打开，小电就跟你打招呼。它还记得你家：三口之家，目标一年省六百块。
en: Open it and it greets you. It remembers: a family of three, aiming to save ¥600 a year.

zh: 这些记忆，都是 AI 从以前的聊天里自己记下来的。孩子几点洗澡，爸爸几点充电，全都有。
en: It wrote these memories itself from past chats — when the kid showers, when Dad charges his e-bike.

zh: 十月账单来了，拍照丢给它！
en: October's bill is here — snap it and drop it in!

zh: 电费比上个月少了三十九块。看起来不错？别急，侦探从不只看表面。
en: ¥39 less than last month. Looks good? Hold on — a detective never stops at the surface.

zh: AI 把这三十九块拆开：十五块是天气转凉、空调少开；真正来自省钱计划的，只有二十四块，只兑现了预期的百分之四十！
en: The AI splits it: ¥15 came from cooler weather; only ¥24 came from the plan — just 40% of what was expected!

zh: 为什么？它翻出一条记忆：孩子每天晚上八点洗澡。洗完澡，热水器在峰段自动补热，把谷电定时的效果抵消了。
en: Why? It recalls a memory: the kid showers at 8 pm, and the heater reheats at peak price, cancelling the off-peak timer.

zh: 真相只有一个！办法也很简单：保温调到五十五度，关掉洗后自动加热。
en: There's only one truth! The fix is simple: keep water at 55°C and turn off post-shower reheating.

zh: 我们回一句：好的，另外下个月要买电动汽车。
en: We reply: OK — and we're buying an electric car next month.

zh: 它立刻记住买车这件事，还算好了账：下班就充，一个月一百三十一块；改到深夜谷电充，只要六十六块。
en: It remembers the car right away and does the math: ¥131 a month charging after work, only ¥66 at night.

zh: 每条措施都有计算依据和回本时间。从建议、采纳、执行到验证，下个月再拿新账单核对，形成闭环。
en: Every measure shows its math and payback. Suggest, adopt, execute, verify — then check next month's bill. A closed loop.

zh: 月底，一键生成月报，发现了什么、改了什么，清清楚楚。
en: At month's end, one tap makes a report: what was found, what changed.

zh: 顺便一提，家里跳闸也能问它。遇到危险情况，它会提醒你：先断电，找持证电工！
en: Breaker tripping? Ask it too. When it's dangerous, it tells you: cut the power, call a licensed electrician!

zh: 技术上，大模型负责看懂账单、记住生活、推理原因；所有数字交给电气计算引擎，用工具调用连在一起，一分钱都不瞎编。
en: Under the hood: the LLM reads bills, remembers life and reasons; an electrical engine does every number, linked by tool calling.

zh: 记性超好的电费侦探，陪你把每一度电都花明白。我是 Claude，咱们下个案子见！
en: Watt Detective remembers, so every kWh makes sense. I'm Claude — see you on the next case!
